description: This file defines extension methods for handling nullable reference types within the MigraDoc.DocumentObjectModel namespace, specifically providing utility methods to check if various types are null or empty.

classes.name: NrtExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for nullable reference types to determine null or emptiness.

methods.name: IsValueNullOrEmpty (string?)
methods.description: Checks if a string is null or empty.

methods.name: IsValueNullOrEmpty (Color?)
methods.description: Checks if a Color? is null or its underlying value is null.

methods.name: IsValueNullOrEmpty (Unit?)
methods.description: Checks if a Unit? is null or its underlying value is null.

methods.name: IsValueNullOrEmpty (TopPosition?)
methods.description: Checks if a TopPosition? is null or its underlying value is null.

methods.name: IsValueNullOrEmpty (LeftPosition?)
methods.description: Checks if a LeftPosition? is null or its underlying value is null.

methods.name: IsValueNullOrEmpty (DocumentObject?)
methods.description: Checks if a DocumentObject? is null or its IsNull() method returns true.
